correctness.rationale: After centering, the exact DIANA second moments close under a \(3\times3\) deterministic matrix. The complete cubic Jury criterion gives the binding inequality \(n(2+s-s^2)>2s(s+2)\), with root \(s_n=[n-4+\sqrt{9n^2+8n+16}]/[2(n+2)]\). All other Jury inequalities are shown strict before this root, and \(P(1)=0\) at equality.

value.rationale: DIANA is designed to exploit independent compressed worker messages while learning local gradient shifts. The exact law \(s_n=[n-4+\sqrt{9n^2+8n+16}]/[2(n+2)]\) turns the qualitative worker-averaging benefit into a sharp stability boundary, showing recovery of the uncompressed ceiling \(2\) with finite-worker deficit \(16/(3n)+O(n^{-2})\).
